title: 第25章 魔女之森第26章 麻烦
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
来到镇外
狄曼列看了看四处无人，手杖在地上划了一圈，开始绘制魔法阵
这时，被他扛在肩上的主教娅莫无比惊讶的开口：“你是个魔法师？！”
狄曼列瞥了她一眼：“不像吗？”
娅莫瞪大了眼睛，看了看狄曼列手上还带着血的手杖，又想起了刚刚枭首一人的巨大镰刀：“哪里像了？”
“刻板印象”
或许是知道自己难逃一死，娅莫咬了咬牙：“告诉我你是怎么追踪到我们的！我把所有情报都告诉你！”
狄曼列再次看了她一眼，没有说话，也不打算回应
至于情报，狄曼列总有办法撬开她的嘴，这事他做了很多年
而且，狄曼列也不准备自己优先来审问她，鸢尾花监狱里有个更合适的人
眼见狄曼列不为所动，娅莫艰难的挣扎了一下：“告诉我！不然我.......”
嗤—————！
利刃划过肉块的声音响起，娅莫在声音响起后的几秒才感到自己的脸庞被温热所覆盖
她茫然的看着掉落在地上的耳朵，这时疼痛才攀上她身躯，嘶吼一同响起
“啊啊啊啊，啊啊！！！！”
凄厉的声音响起，狄曼列的表情依旧平静，不顾在挣扎的娅莫，扛着她走进了画好的魔法阵中
一阵光芒闪过，狄曼列与娅莫已经来到了鸢尾花监狱的大门前
瞬间，本来正在捂着自己不断流出鲜血的的伤口的娅莫整个人仿佛忘记疼痛，呆呆的看着眼前的鸢尾花监狱
“你，你刚刚这么短时间内画了一个传送魔法阵？！你凭什么做到？！你到底是几级魔法师？！”
无视娅莫的声音，狄曼列走进了鸢尾花监狱

“啊，典狱长！”
一位年轻的狱警看见狄曼列后赶忙上前，非常熟练的开口：“我来把她送到牢房区域吧”
“不用，她还要审问”，狄曼列笑着摇了摇头：“你们正常工作就行，不用管”
“是！”
年轻的美女狱警双眼亮了一下，心情愉悦的回到了自己的巡逻岗位
狄曼列看了一眼充满活力的狱警，也是忍不住笑了笑
鸢尾花监狱的人员变动不大，狱警数量也不算多。目前鸢尾花监狱的狱警大部分都是不太在乎薪水和前途的
她们中有相当一部分都是有钱人家的小姐或者干脆就是大小贵族，来到这里当狱警的原因也各不相同
有的只是想找个远离帝国权力中心的地方摆烂，有的则是追求刺激才来面对这些危险的犯人
许多其他城市不愿意接手的重刑犯大部分都被送到了鸢尾花监狱，毕竟瘦死的骆驼比马大，所有人都知道狄曼列曾是一位强大的异端审判官。就算他受的伤再重也不是其他那些弱鸡典狱长可以比的
还有些狱警，则和某只魅魔一样就是单纯冲着狄曼列来的
至于在乎薪水和前途的人，也早就离开鸢尾花监狱另寻出路了
content_en:
Came outside the town
Diamanlie looked around and saw that there was no one around. He drew a circle on the ground with his cane and began to draw the magic circle.
At this time, Bishop Yamo, who was being carried on his shoulders, said in great surprise: "Are you a magician?!"
Diamanlie glanced at her: "Isn't it like that?"
Yamo's eyes widened, and he looked at the blood-stained cane in Diamanlie's hand, and then thought of the huge scythe that had just dominated him: "Where does it look like?"
"Stereotype"
Perhaps knowing that he would inevitably die, Yamo gritted his teeth: "Tell me how you tracked us! I will tell you all the information!"
Diamanlie glanced at her again, saying nothing and not planning to respond.
As for information, Diamanlie always has a way to pry her mouth open. He has been doing this for many years.
Moreover, Diamanlie was not prepared to interrogate her first. There was a more suitable person in Iris Prison.
Seeing that Diamanlie was unmoved, Yamo struggled hard: "Tell me! Otherwise I..."
Tsk————!
The sound of a sharp blade cutting through flesh was heard, and it was only a few seconds after the sound that Yamo felt that his face was covered with warmth.
She looked blankly at her ear that had fallen to the ground. Only then did the pain creep up on her body, and she heard a roar.
"Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhh!!!"
A shrill voice sounded, but Diamanlie's expression remained calm. Regardless of the struggling Yamo, he carried her into the drawn magic circle.
A burst of light flashed, and Diamanlie and Yamo had arrived at the gate of Iris Prison.
In an instant, Yamo, who was covering his wounds that were bleeding continuously, seemed to have forgotten the pain and stared blankly at the Iris Prison in front of him.
"You, you just drew a teleportation magic circle in such a short time?! Why did you do it?! What level of magician are you?!"
Ignoring Yamo's voice, Diamanlie walked into the Iris Prison.
"Ah, the Warden!"
A young prison guard saw Dimanlie and hurried forward and said very skillfully: "Let me send her to the cell area."
"No, she still wants to interrogate." Diamanlie smiled and shook his head: "You can just go about your business normally, don't worry about it."
"Yes!"
The young beautiful prison guard's eyes lit up and she returned to her patrol post in a happy mood.
Diamanlie glanced at the energetic prison guard and couldn't help but smile.
The staff at Iris Prison has not changed much, and the number of prison guards is not large. At present, most of the prison guards at Iris Prison don't care much about their salary or future.
Quite a few of them are young ladies from wealthy families or simply nobles, and they come here to work as prison guards for different reasons.
Some just want to find a place to hang out far away from the center of imperial power, while others are looking for excitement to face these dangerous prisoners.
Most of the felons who were unwilling to be taken over by many other cities were sent to Iris Prison. After all, a skinny camel was bigger than a horse. Everyone knew that Diamenlie was once a powerful heretic inquisitor. No matter how badly he was injured, he couldn't compare to those weak wardens.
There are also some prison guards who, like a certain succubus, are simply here for Diamanlie.
As for those who care about salary and future, they have already left Iris Prison to find another way out.
